title: Ex 1.4 #5 · 𝒫(𝒫({2}))
prompt: Write $\mathscr{P}(\mathscr{P}(\{2\}))$ by listing its elements between braces.
answer_format: A set of sets between braces, like {∅, {1}, {1, 2}}. Spaces are optional.
hints: Work from the inside: first find 𝒫({2}), a set with two elements.
The power set is the set of all subsets, including ∅ and the set itself. A set with k elements has 2ᵏ of them: here you need 4.
solution: List every subset, from ∅ up to the whole set: 4 in all.
